author: Marc4360
body: Annwn + briny pendant accessories for dot coverage.  Some sort of dragon resistance, either a Mighty Griffin Shield or Fey Dragon chest/boots.  You don't need petrification immunity so you can drop cockatrice mail and wear something that gives better protection/ward (FYC, Realm Garb, Arisen Hel's Garb, etc).  Curse immunity would be good too (Avalon Crown, Arisen/Fallen Shield).

author: DeadliestSin
body:
/u/marc4360 nailed the equipment perfectly so I won't go into any detail there.

However, your strategy is just as important as your build.

You must start with WoO (mithril is less ideal but feasible) or you can be one shot. Then db2 or if you can tank a couple hits throw golems resistance and barrier 2 and a berserk (I use both the raider specialization and Fey Chimera for berserk 1 and 3) in there.

Then complete your buffs and use an ambrosia or panacea to remove the negatives, drop your health back to 1 and go wild.

You'll want to test out if gait of gunnr is worth it or not, but I don't find the increase in damage I take is worth it.

author: abdominalbenito
body:
Base ward scales with your health, so using health increasing ornaments will also increase your ward a pretty decent amount. Usually more than the ward increasing ornaments themself.

Edit: Forgot to add base ward also scales with mana at the same rate it does with health. It’s an average of the two that determines ward.

author: Indexicans
body:
Ward is your friend, I’m the exact same class and spec, I can hit 5-7 mil on morri in one run, I have no crazy armor or anything, realm katana though is your best friend IMO for raids, it drops from Apollyon, grind that out because it will be a lifesaver with extra ward also had confirmation from Major on orna legends that ward adorns help more compared to health or mana adorns, not sure what classes you have rn, more specifically skills available to you, but the strat I use is fey yeti for ward upkeep, start off with golem’s fortitude, then 
barrier II, ward of ortanite next, then berserk III, then warcry and last but not least bears might, right after this I pop a panacea, and use divine bastion 1 (I haven’t bought the better ones), and just spam bastion 3 until I’m redlined, usually my ward will be down by 5k around here and I pop a mend wall 2 to recover and then go to work on morri with swordplay 3 


Armor wise, I personally use ornate fey yeti Antlers, however your ONC is dope, just fill it with ward adorns (doesn’t matter what the adorn says besides ward: 2%) my weapon is a realm katana, (decent attack with ward bonuses, I put ward adorns in this too) and then my chest actually has no ward at all, I’m sorely lacking there and my offhand has the exact same amount of ward as yours. My leg gear also offers no ward, just good res and def, accessories go with Annwn and briny

author: Faerlina
body: Also switch to Charmer instead of Raider. The additional 30% mana will also increase your Ward. Raider also has -20% HP, which decreases your Ward. Warrior's Pavane is an absolutely broken skill imo. That much damage for just 60 Mana. You will waste less turns potion chugging, which favers your Deific Channel uptime. Also the Lull debuff from Charmer wastes turns on Morri. Oh and get 2-3 Assassins Jewels in there.

author: [deleted]
body:
You should try to get your hands on a Fallen/Arisen shield, mimics mischief is not guaranteed to lower your stats, you get curse immunity, and more Ward.

You could also swap to Berserker and use Fey Yeti/Great Yeti for elemental resists and Fey will give you passive ward heals. Lower HP penalty will also add ward.
